function.name: gmail_search
function.description: Search the user's Gmail and list matching threads (subject, sender, date, snippet, labels). Uses Gmail search syntax, e.g. 'from:alice newer_than:7d', 'is:unread in:inbox', 'subject:invoice has:attachment'. Use gmail_read_thread to read full messages.

query.description: Gmail search query. Empty lists recent inbox threads.

function.name: gmail_read_thread
function.description: Read every message in a Gmail thread: headers, plain-text body, and attachment names. Message ids in the result can be passed as reply_to_message_id when drafting or sending a reply.

function.name: gmail_list_labels
function.description: List the user's Gmail labels (system labels like INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, plus user labels).

function.name: gmail_create_draft
function.description: Create a Gmail draft (plain text). The user reviews it before it is created. Set reply_to_message_id to draft a reply in an existing thread; subject then defaults to 'Re: <original>'. Prefer drafting over sending unless the user explicitly asks to send.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional Gmail message id (from gmail_read_thread) this draft replies to.

function.name: gmail_send
function.description: Send an email (plain text) from the user's Gmail. The user must approve before it is sent. Only use when the user explicitly asks to send; otherwise use gmail_create_draft. Set reply_to_message_id to reply within an existing thread.

reply_to_message_id.description: Optional Gmail message id (from gmail_read_thread) this message replies to.

function.name: gmail_modify_threads
function.description: Add or remove labels on Gmail threads. The user approves first. Archive = remove INBOX; mark read = remove UNREAD; mark unread = add UNREAD; star = add STARRED. Labels may be given by name or id.

add_labels.description: Label names or ids to add.

remove_labels.description: Label names or ids to remove.
